methods.label: Translate a decrease into chart direction
methods.explanation: Daylight lasts 15 hours at the summer solstice and decreases to 12 hours at the autumn equinox. The value decreases, so the curve falls.
methods.levelReason: Recognizing a decrease as a downward chart trend is elementary line-graph interpretation.
